raw_text: FACT CHECK: The viral image of PM Modi and President Xi Jinping shaking hands warmly at the G20 is NOT a real photograph. The Quint's WebQoof team ran the image through multiple AI detection tools including Hive Moderation and Illuminarty, both of which returned high probability scores for AI generation (0.96 and 0.91 respectively). The image exhibits tell-tale signs: the fingers on Modi's right hand show an extra joint, the lapel pin is on the wrong side, and the background delegates have distorted facial features. No wire service — Reuters, AP, AFP, or PTI — has any matching image in their archives. The actual Modi-Xi interaction at G20 was brief and formal, with no such elaborate handshake.
